connectorUiConfig.title: Censys Supply Chain Risk Events (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: This connector ingests the Censys Supplier Risk Intelligence risk-events change feed (`/v1/supplychains/default/risk-events`) into Microsoft Sentinel. `default` resolves to the single supply chain associated with the Censys organization. The feed is append-only and delivers `opened`, `resolved`, and `reopened` state transitions for risk instances, each carrying a full snapshot of the risk instance at the time of the change.

sampleQueries.description: Get a sample of Censys risk events
Newly opened critical and high severity risks
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where ChangeType in ('opened', 'reopened')
| where Severity in ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH')
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, RiskName, SupplierDisplayName, AssetIp, AssetHostname, PlatformUrl
| order by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Currently open risks per supplier (latest event per instance)
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| summarize arg_max(InsertedAt, *) by RiskInstanceId
| where Status == 'open'
| summarize OpenRisks = count() by SupplierDisplayName, Severity
| order by OpenRisks desc

sampleQueries.description: Risk events mapped to known CVEs
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| summarize AffectedAssets = dcount(RiskInstanceId) by CveId, Severity
| order by AffectedAssets desc

customs.name: Censys Personal Access Token
customs.description: A Censys personal access token, created at https://accounts.censys.io/settings/personal-access-tokens. Users on Starter, Search, and Core plans require the API Access role.

customs.name: Censys Organization ID
customs.description: The UUID of the Censys organization whose risk events should be collected. Risk events are collected from the organization's default supply chain, so the organization must have a supply chain.

instructionSteps.title: Obtain Censys credentials
instructionSteps.description: Create a personal access token at [Censys account settings](https://accounts.censys.io/settings/personal-access-tokens). Users on Starter, Search, and Core plans need the API Access role. Copy the organization ID of the Censys organization and, optionally, the ID(s) of the supplier(s) you want to restrict collection to.

parameters.content: Create a personal access token at [Censys account settings](https://accounts.censys.io/settings/personal-access-tokens). Users on Starter, Search, and Core plans need the API Access role. Copy the organization ID of the Censys organization and, optionally, the ID(s) of the supplier(s) you want to restrict collection to.

instructionSteps.title: Connect Censys to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Enter the personal access token and organization ID, optionally set the initial start time and narrow what is collected using the supplier IDs and filters, then select Connect.

parameters.label: Personal Access Token
parameters.name: apikey
parameters.placeholder: Enter your Censys personal access token

parameters.content:
### Optional filters
All settings below are optional. Leave a filter empty to collect everything for that dimension - an empty filter is not sent to the Censys API at all. Leave the initial start time empty to collect the full history (all events Censys still retains). Risk events are always collected from the organization's default supply chain.

parameters.label: Risk type IDs
parameters.name: riskTypeIds
parameters.placeholder: Comma-separated CVE IDs or Censys catalog IDs, for example CVE-2021-44228,CENSYS-2022-1194

options.text: reopened - previously resolved risk instance opened again

parameters.label: Rapid response
parameters.name: rapidResponse
parameters.placeholder: Both rapid response and non-rapid response findings
